facts.text: I am looking to restock my tackle box with new hooks and sinkers.
I received a tip from a local tackle shop owner about a secret spot near a dam where the fish are always biting.
I usually use spin casting with spinners and power bait as lures.
I have had good luck with garlic-scented power bait.
I usually stick to chartreuse or pink colors for power bait.
I have been wanting to try out a new bass lure I ordered online.
I saw a video from @FishingFanatic on social media where he caught a massive bass using that lure.
I have been wanting to try that new bass lure for a while.
I have been meaning to try a slower retrieve with my spinners.
I caught a 3-pound trout at Lake Michigan last weekend with my buddy Alex.
My buddy Alex and I were using spinners and power bait.
The trout were aggressive that day.
